name: Comments
description: Comments on whatever a module registers as commentable — a page today, a product tomorrow. One table with a target registry rather than a comment system per entity. Placed as a block, so where comments appear is the merchant's choice; premoderated by default, and guarded by the same core FormGuard that protects the enquiry forms.

settings.label: Check comments before publishing
settings.help: On by default, and worth leaving on: a shop that finds casino adverts under its terms of sale switches comments off for good, which is the same outcome as never having them.

settings.label: Tell this address about new comments
settings.help: Empty means the storefront's own contact address. A comment waiting for moderation that nobody knows about is the reason this is sent by the module itself rather than left to a rule.
